row: Release is a boutique physical therapy practice in Washington, DC that provides the best in comprehensive, evidence-based treatments and personalized care. Utilizing hands-on techniques, we strive to relieve pain, improve function, and enhance health and wellness. Whether you’re an athlete that plays hard on the field, or a weekend warrior that plays hard in life, committing to a physical therapy program can help to keep you moving forward. Release Physical Therapy – Washington, DC will help you get back to work, back in the game, and back to doing the activities you love. Subscribe for great how-to exercises or visit www.releasept.com!
